description: Governance assessment template aligned with ISO/IEC 42001 requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an AI management system.

domains.name: Context of the Organization
domains.description: Understanding the organization and its context, needs and expectations of interested parties, and scope of the AI management system.

controls.name: Organizational Context Analysis
controls.description: Determine external and internal issues relevant to the organization's purpose that affect AI management system outcomes.

controls.name: Stakeholder Requirements
controls.description: Identify interested parties relevant to the AI management system and their requirements.

controls.name: AIMS Scope Definition
controls.description: Define boundaries and applicability of the AI management system scope.

domains.name: Leadership & Commitment
domains.description: Top management leadership, AI policy establishment, and organizational roles/responsibilities.

controls.name: Leadership Commitment
controls.description: Demonstrate top management commitment to the AI management system.

controls.name: AI Policy
controls.description: Establish an AI policy appropriate to the organization's purpose and providing a framework for setting AI objectives.

controls.name: Roles and Responsibilities
controls.description: Assign and communicate roles, responsibilities, and authorities for the AI management system.

domains.name: Planning
domains.description: Actions to address risks and opportunities, AI objectives, and planning of changes.

controls.name: Risk and Opportunity Assessment
controls.description: Determine risks and opportunities that need to be addressed to ensure the AI management system achieves intended outcomes.

controls.name: AI Risk Assessment
controls.description: Establish and maintain an AI risk assessment process covering AI-specific risks such as bias, safety, and transparency.

controls.name: AI Objectives and Planning
controls.description: Establish measurable AI objectives at relevant functions and levels, and plan how to achieve them.

domains.name: Support & Resources
domains.description: Resources, competence, awareness, communication, and documented information.

controls.name: Resource Allocation
controls.description: Determine and provide resources needed for the AI management system.

controls.name: Competence and Training
controls.description: Ensure persons involved in AI systems are competent based on education, training, or experience.

controls.name: Documentation and Records
controls.description: Maintain documented information required by the AI management system.

domains.name: Operation
domains.description: Operational planning and control, AI risk treatment, and AI system impact assessment.

controls.name: Operational Planning and Control
controls.description: Plan, implement, and control processes needed to meet AI management system requirements.

controls.name: AI System Impact Assessment
controls.description: Conduct impact assessments for AI systems considering effects on individuals and society.

controls.name: AI System Lifecycle Management
controls.description: Manage AI systems throughout their lifecycle including design, development, deployment, and decommissioning.

controls.name: Data Governance for AI
controls.description: Establish data quality, provenance, and governance requirements for AI system data.

domains.name: Performance Evaluation
domains.description: Monitoring, measurement, analysis, evaluation, internal audit, and management review.

controls.name: Monitoring and Measurement
controls.description: Determine what needs to be monitored and measured for AI management system performance.

controls.name: Internal Audit
controls.description: Conduct internal audits at planned intervals to verify AI management system conformity.

controls.name: Management Review
controls.description: Review the AI management system at planned intervals to ensure continuing suitability and effectiveness.

domains.name: Improvement
domains.description: Nonconformity, corrective action, and continual improvement.

controls.name: Nonconformity and Corrective Action
controls.description: React to nonconformities, evaluate the need for corrective action, and implement changes.

controls.name: Continual Improvement
controls.description: Continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the AI management system.
